defect: The rewritten StringCompressInternal/StringDecompress put the string bytes at wrong offsets for result types wider than the inline length (no zero padding, first byte not in the most significant position), and decompress copies sizeof(INPUT_TYPE)-1 bytes into the 12-byte inline buffer (overflowing it for hugeint) and leaves the remaining inline bytes uninitialised.
reason: The fix (fix refactor bugs, one day later) rewrites exactly these added lines to place the length byte and the reversed bytes correctly and zero the remainder, and the wrong offsets and missing padding can be read off the diff together with string_t's 4+12 byte layout.

defect: With DECIMAL now in LogicalType::NUMERIC, the unchanged unary + loop already registers a DECIMAL NopFunction and the change adds a second identical one, so unary + on a decimal fails with an ambiguous-candidate binder error, and both declare a width-less DECIMAL return type instead of the input type.
reason: The fix removes the duplicate line and gives the DECIMAL unary + a bind that sets the return type to the child type; the other loops in the diff skip DECIMAL from NUMERIC, so the duplicate overload is visible in the diff.

defect: should_round is computed as NEGATIVE ? digit <= -5 : digit >= 5 with an unsigned digit 0..9, so it is always false for negative inputs and negative decimals are never rounded.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to digit >= 5, and the uint8_t digit parameter is in the diff.

defect: ProfilingModeSetting::SetLocal now resets profiler_settings to the defaults for both standard and detailed, so setting profiling_mode silently discards metrics the user set via custom_profiling_settings.
reason: The fix (fix bug) deletes exactly those added reset lines (plus the older emit_profiler_output line), and the follow-up test commit adds explicit RESET custom_profiling_settings, confirming that settings are meant to survive a profiling_mode change.

defect: No defect in this change; the fix replaces -1 * with T(-1) * in the DEBUG assertion because a later commit (ba4d2fd) commented out operator*(idx_t, hugeint_t), on which -1 * hugeint_t relied.
reason: At 153fca9 the expression resolved to operator*(idx_t, hugeint_t), which builds hugeint_t(-1), so it compiled and evaluated correctly; the breakage came from the later removal of that operator.

defect: The new merge functions (MergeByte, MergeNodeWithNode16OrNode4/48/256) take l_node by value and never update the parent's child pointer, so when InsertChildNode grows l_node the parent and the caller's loop keep a pointer to the freed node (use-after-free, segfault).
reason: The fix adds l_node_parent/l_node_pos to these declarations and calls ReplaceChildPointer after InsertChildNode in MergeByte, code added by this change, but the faulty logic is in node.cpp, not in the header diff.

defect: The new early return result; returns a unique_ptr<BoundSelectNode> from a function declared to return unique_ptr<BoundQueryNode> without move, which GCC 4.9 (a configuration in the project's Travis CI) rejects.
reason: The fix (Fix for gcc4.9) changes exactly this added line to return move(result), and the derived-to-base unique_ptr return is visible in the diff.

defect: HeapGatherArrayVector computes array_start as i * array_size instead of col_idx * array_size, so with a non-identity selection vector the gathered child elements land in the wrong array rows.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line (which even carries a TODO asking whether it is i or col_idx) to col_idx * array_size.

defect: The fix switches ColumnDataCopyArray from copying a contiguous child range starting at first_offset to copying a selection-sliced child vector, so array children of sliced or dictionary vectors (nested sort) are copied correctly.
reason: The code before this change also copied a contiguous child range that ignored the source selection vector (with an unscaled offset as well), so the defect the fix repairs was already present before this change, which only rewrote it.

defect: PrintErrorHeader now prints the header via LogFailure to stderr and then again via the new LogFailureAnnotation to stdout, so every error header in the test runner output appears twice.
reason: The fix (fix doubled error headers) removes the added LogFailure call and makes LogFailureAnnotation the single print path; the duplicated file:line text it also removes was older, but the double print comes from this change.

defect: The sqlite callback dereferences GetRowRenderer() unconditionally although it returns nullptr in TRASH mode, and exec_prepared_stmt now reads column types once from the first row instead of per row, so a later NULL value trips the OOM check and stops the output.
reason: The fix adds the null check in callback and moves sqlite3_column_type back into the per-row loop, both repairing lines added by this change; the diff itself checks if (renderer) elsewhere and shows the type read moved out of the loop.

defect: The new ModeJsonRenderer prints 1e999 for -inf instead of -1e999.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to -1e999, matching the shell.cpp code the change replaced, and the copy-paste slip is visible in the diff.

defect: The STRUCT case of FormatSerialize writes a children list of length count (the row count) and indexes entries[i] for i < count instead of entries.size(), reading past the entries vector and serialising a wrong child list.
reason: The old code iterated over entries.size(); the fix (fix struct vector oob) changes exactly this added line back to entries.size().
